paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy for different models. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Frames,” is linear, ranging from 10 to 60 with tick labels every 10 units. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, is linear, ranging from 40 to 54 with tick labels every 2 units. 

A blue line, labeled “Ours (Dynamic Seg),” begins at approximately 52.5% accuracy at 10 frames and increases to approximately 52.7% accuracy at 20 frames, remaining relatively constant up to 50 frames, then increasing slightly to approximately 52.8% at 60 frames; the line is solid and includes circular markers. A green line, labeled “Ours (Static 4-Seg),” starts at approximately 52.6% accuracy at 10 frames, increases to approximately 52.8% at 20 frames, and remains relatively constant to approximately 52.9% at 60 frames; this line is solid with circular markers. An orange line, labeled “PLLaVA (DP 8),” begins at approximately 44.4% accuracy at 10 frames and decreases linearly to approximately 40.2% accuracy at 60 frames; this line is dashed with square markers. A maroon line, labeled “PLLaVA (DP 16),” starts at approximately 44.5% accuracy at 10 frames and also decreases linearly to approximately 40.7% accuracy at 60 frames; this line is dashed with square markers.
